title: Integrate RBAC v2 checks into control-plane endpoints (org/project admin, API keys, model rollouts)
creator: Ethan Park
description:
## Context
We need consistent RBAC v2 enforcement across the control-plane service so that enterprise customers can rely on least-privilege and separation-of-duties. Today we have a mix of RBAC v1 feature gates + ad-hoc checks, with gaps called out during the permission inventory.

This ticket wires RBAC v2 checks (resource/action/scope) into the highest-risk control-plane endpoints:
- Org/tenant administration (org settings, membership, SSO config entry points owned by control plane)
- Project administration (create/delete, member role bindings, environment config)
- API keys (create/rotate/revoke/list) and service tokens
- Model serving lifecycle actions (model version pinning, rollouts, canary settings, fallback policies)

RBAC v2 primitives and middleware hook are introduced in:
- redwood PR #18432 (core types + middleware scaffolding)
- redwood PR #18451 (standardized 403 reason codes + logging fields)

We should implement checks in-service (not only at gateway) per the authz standard and to support Private deployments where gateway topology differs.

## Scope
### In-scope endpoints (initial set)
**Org / tenant admin**
- POST /orgs (create org)
- PATCH /orgs/:org_id (update org settings)
- POST /orgs/:org_id/members (invite)
- DELETE /orgs/:org_id/members/:user_id (remove)
- POST /orgs/:org_id/role-bindings (assign role)
- DELETE /orgs/:org_id/role-bindings/:binding_id

**Projects**
- POST /orgs/:org_id/projects
- PATCH /orgs/:org_id/projects/:project_id
- DELETE /orgs/:org_id/projects/:project_id
- POST /orgs/:org_id/projects/:project_id/members
- DELETE /orgs/:org_id/projects/:project_id/members/:user_id

**API keys**
- GET /orgs/:org_id/api-keys
- POST /orgs/:org_id/api-keys
- POST /orgs/:org_id/api-keys/:key_id/rotate
- DELETE /orgs/:org_id/api-keys/:key_id

**Model rollouts / serving config**
- POST /orgs/:org_id/projects/:project_id/serving/model-pins
- PATCH /orgs/:org_id/projects/:project_id/serving/rollouts/:rollout_id
- POST /orgs/:org_id/projects/:project_id/serving/rollouts (create)
- POST /orgs/:org_id/projects/:project_id/serving/rollouts/:rollout_id/canary
- POST /orgs/:org_id/projects/:project_id/serving/fallback-policies

### Out of scope (this ticket)
- Console backend routes that proxy to other services (tracked in ENG-5386)
- Data-plane inference authorization beyond org/project scoping
- Deep identity provider changes (SSO/SAML), except mapping claim->role that is required for accurate enforcement

## Implementation plan
1) For each endpoint above, map to RBAC v2 action names (per ENG-5383 taxonomy) and resource scope:
- org:<org_id>
- project:<project_id>
- api_key:<key_id> (where applicable)
- rollout:<rollout_id> (where applicable)

2) Wire checks through shared authz library (ENG-5384) at the handler/service layer:
- Resolve actor principal (user/service token/support session)
- Construct check input: {actor, action, resource, scope, context}
- Evaluate policy (cacheable per org) and return standardized 403 with reason codes on deny

3) Ensure audit log enrichment hooks are invoked consistently:
- Include decision context: allow/deny, policy_version, role_ids, reason_code
- Note: full exporter wiring tracked in ENG-5387, but control-plane must emit fields

4) Add tests:
- Unit tests: action mapping for each route + deny/allow behavior
- Integration tests (table-driven): least-privileged roles cannot perform admin actions
- Regression tests for RBAC v1->v2 dual-eval mode (shadow deny metric only) when feature flag enabled

## Acceptance criteria
- All in-scope endpoints have an explicit RBAC v2 permission check before state changes are applied.
- Endpoints return standardized errors:
  - HTTP 403 with machine-readable reason_code (e.g., AUTHZ_DENY, AUTHZ_SCOPE_MISMATCH, AUTHZ_MISSING_PERMISSION)
  - No leakage of policy internals in the response (OK to include request_id).
- Authz decision fields are present in structured logs for allow and deny (per PR #18451 fields):
  - authz.decision, authz.action, authz.resource, authz.scope, authz.policy_version, authz.reason_code
- Tests:
  - Add/extend integration tests covering at least: Org Admin, Developer, Billing Admin, Read-only
  - Add a negative test for each sensitive category: membership changes, key revoke, rollout update
- Rollout safety:
  - Feature flag for enforcement (dual-eval/shadow mode supported per ENG-5389)
  - Shadow-deny metrics emitted for mismatches between v1 and v2 (to be monitored during rollout)

## Notes / decisions
- Enforcement location: service-level checks required; gateway checks may exist but are not sufficient.
- Support/break-glass: endpoints must respect elevated support session constraints (time-bounded session). Break-glass creation/plumbing is tracked separately (PR #18560).
- Deny semantics: follow ADR-014 (deny-overrides if we introduce explicit denies; for now bundle is allow-only + implicit deny).

## Links
- ENG-5383 RBAC v2 taxonomy
- ENG-5384 shared authz library
- ENG-5389 migration (dual-eval + feature flags)
- GitHub:
  - redwood PR #18432 (RBAC v2 types + middleware)
  - redwood PR #18451 (standard authz errors + logging)
  - redwood PR #18480 (API key endpoints RBAC v2)
  - redwood PR #18505 (Dedicated admin endpoints; related patterns)
  - redwood PR #18579 (dual-evaluation mode)

## Open questions
- Do we treat "create org" as a platform-admin-only action? Current behavior allows self-serve; proposal is allow for authenticated users, but restrict org-level configuration thereafter. Needs Security sign-off.
- Model rollout actions: do we split read vs write vs "promote to 100%"? Proposed actions:
  - serving.rollout.read
  - serving.rollout.write
  - serving.rollout.promote (high risk)

## Rollout plan (for this ticket)
- Land checks behind authz.enforce_rbac_v2_control_plane=false by default.
- Enable in staging in shadow mode for 48h, review shadow denies.
- Enable enforcement for internal orgs first, then Hosted canary tier.
comments: 2025-02-10 (Kaitlyn Nguyen): Please keep action naming aligned with ENG-5383. For API keys, use api_keys.create/api_keys.rotate/api_keys.revoke, not key.*. Also make sure list vs read is consistent across services.

2025-02-12 (Brian Murphy): For rollouts, we should treat 'promote' as separate from 'update canary weights' to support least privilege. Customers asked to prevent juniors from pushing 100% during incident response.

2025-02-18 (Jordan Lee): Re: org create action: we can keep self-serve org create out of RBAC (pre-org). Once org exists, RBAC applies. In code, avoid requiring a policy lookup for org creation path, since there's no org scope yet.
2025-02-20 (Marcus Lin): Ensure membership endpoints include audit log fields even on deny. We need evidence for SOC2 around attempted unauthorized access (denied invites/removals).

2025-02-26 (Leila Farouk): For integration tests, recommend table-driven fixtures using the policy bundle v0.1 and role bindings created in setup. We should pin policy_version in tests to avoid bundle drift breaking CI.
2025-03-03 (Connor O'Brien): Please confirm feature flag name and add to rollout dashboard. Release coordination wants a single 'control_plane_rbac_v2_enforce' toggle per environment.
updates: 2025-02-06: Ticket created; scope aligned with permission inventory P0 endpoints.
2025-02-14: Implemented checks for org/project admin handlers locally; pending review for action naming + error semantics.
2025-02-21: Opened PR for API key endpoints (PR #18480) with integration tests; addressed reason_code formatting to match PR #18451.
2025-02-27: Added rollout endpoints checks behind flag; observed minor perf regression (~0.4ms p95) due to policy fetch on cold cache—expect mitigation via cache PR #18477.
2025-03-04: In review; waiting on Security sign-off for org-create behavior and final action split for rollout.promote.
